An empty place awaiting visitors, with unlettered surfaces. VALE'S EMPTY STATION, complementary IVORY to his black clothes. A tiny forgotten wooden railway waiting hall opens at its far end onto two tracks that vanish into pale lake mist. Broad worn timber floor in the foreground, stairs rising along left wall, open station door at right toward the pond. Intimate, worn, quietly impossible; plenty of airy shadow and one small amber lamp. Ivory is a gentle material accent, the whole image remains naturally balanced.
